pairs.registryProposal: For a single-user local-first desktop app there is no session or unauthenticated visitor; the standard should say whether a first-run sample shown on an empty workspace (with a dismissable notice, persistent badge and scan/add CTAs) counts as auto-entry or as an acceptable onboarding door, since clause 2 currently reads as forbidding it outright.
